stem: What does harvest authorization allow a Technician I to do?
choices: Harvest authorization allows Technician I to release held material if the crop appears acceptable.
Harvest authorization allows destination and lot structure changes when production timing requires it.
Harvest authorization allows execution of the defined task within scope; it does not grant independent release, disposal, or process-redesign authority.
Harvest authorization allows safety controls to be bypassed if the schedule is at risk.
rationale: Authorization is task-specific. Technician I may carry out the approved harvest steps within the defined scope, but separate authorities govern product release, destruction, destination changes, technical process redesign, and safety controls. Keeping those boundaries distinct protects both product control and worker safety.
